spec_notes: Uses pdf-parse (pdfjs-dist based) for text extraction. The PDFParse class requires options { verbosity: 0, data: <Uint8Array> } in constructor. Call load() then getText() which returns { pages: [{text, num}], text: 'full text with page separators', total: N }. The extracted text includes page separator lines like '-- 1 of 1 --'. Works with searchable PDFs only (not scanned/image-based). Requires pdf-parse npm package.
